note: All coords in main.webp px (2400x1796). Draw order: sky (opaque full frame; below the far skyline it is synthesized sky) -> sky_ext -> far -> mid -> women -> fg; sky+far+mid+women+fg reproduces main.webp. sky_ext.webp continues the sky UPWARD: its top row sits at y=-720, height 752; its bottom 32 rows (y=0..31) fade out over the painting's own sky (alpha 1->0), rows y<0 are pure synthesis. far/mid/fg are opaque from their soft top edge down to their bottom (far to y=1120, mid and fg to the bottom), so parallax never opens holes; the women's area is inpainted in far/mid/fg (plate_nowomen.webp = whole painting without the women). mid's top edge follows midTopLine (24-px feather), fg's top edge follows fgTopLine (30-px feather), both run just below everything they must not cut. depth: 0 back .. 4 front.

weakSpots: women.webp keeps a thin band of ground at the feet/hems and between straws of the hand-held sheaves (moves with the women; keeps feet grounded). plate_nowomen/mid inside the women's footprint is quilted ground: fine at parallax offsets up to ~150 px, patchy if the women are removed entirely. The women's cast shadows stay painted on mid. No layer extends below y=1796 or sideways beyond 0..2400: clamp the camera so the bottom edge of fg stays off-screen. sky_ext: first ~25 rows above y=0 are a mirror of the painting's top rows, above that cross-faded shifted copies of its cloud texture over a darker, smoother trend.
